parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Correctly separate variables, $\int e^{-y}\,dy=\int xe^{-x}\,dx$; condone missing integral signs. B1. Obtain $-e^{-y}$. B1. Commence integration by parts and reach $\pm xe^{-x}\pm\int e^{-x}\,dx$. M1; M0 if clearly differentiating a product. Complete the integration to obtain $-xe^{-x}-e^{-x}$. A1. Use $x=0,y=0$ to evaluate a constant, or use limits, in a solution containing or derived from non-zero terms $ae^{-y},bxe^{-x},ce^{-x}$. DM1; working must be seen; a correct form is $-e^{-y}+C=-xe^{-x}-e^{-x}$. Obtain a correct solution in any form from correct working, for example $-e^{-y}=-xe^{-x}-e^{-x}$. A1; A0 if the constant was ignored or assumed zero. Obtain $y=-\ln((x+1)e^{-x})$, equivalently $y=x-\ln(x+1)$ or $y=\ln(e^x/(x+1))$, from correct working. A1; A0 if the constant was ignored or assumed zero. Total 7.
